description: Peruvian Brooch is composed of an articulate fish (8 1/2 by 2 1/2) attached by a chain (1 1/2 long) to a pin (5 x 5 1/2). The pin has 3 branches; the center has a flower, the 2 side ones have leaves. Each branch is topped with a scallop shell motif. A blue stone is in center of each branch. A red stone is at top of center branch.
